'''Averam''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was one of the few planets to openly sympathize with small groups of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] supporters early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

The planet was the site of pro-Alliance activity during the height of the Galactic Civil War. It was on Averam that [[Winter Celchu|Winter]] was known as the "Targeter" although her time on Averam was cut short when [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] discovered the Rebel cell and eliminated it.

Averam natives were called "Averists".

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] places Averam in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Sesswenna sector]] (a misspelling of the true [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]]). Originally thought to be a mistake, this assertion was confirmed as fact in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and ''The Essential Atlas'' online appendix. Both say that Averam is in the Seswenna sector; therefore, it can be assumed that this is a retcon to place Averam in the Seswenna sector rather than the Core as was previously thought.
